2.0.2.title: Wish history by rarity
2.0.2.text: Over the wish history on the Pulls page, show every wish, only the 4★ and 5★, or only the 5★.

2.0.2.title: Characters by rarity
2.0.2.text: Filter the Characters page to the 5★ or the 4★, or sort it by rarity. Press the chosen sort again to reverse its order.

2.0.1.title: Page size
2.0.1.text: Make everything in the window smaller or larger, from 70% to 130%, in Settings or with Ctrl and + or −, or Ctrl and the mouse wheel. A maximized window keeps a size of its own, so a full screen can be smaller than the usual window. Ctrl and 0 goes back to 100%.

2.0.1.title: A Board for a full screen
2.0.1.text: A maximized window keeps its own arrangement of the Board, so its extra columns can be used: arrange it with Edit while the window is maximized. The widgets, their settings and your notes are the same in both.

2.0.1.title: Updates from the code's own page
2.0.1.text: Guild Board now looks for updates in the releases of github.com/QL1STY/guild-board, beside its code, where each installer is built by GitHub from its commit. The old releases page stays as it is.

2.0.0.title: A smoother window
2.0.0.text: The window now draws at your monitor's full rate. No more flashing squares. It uses less memory.

2.0.0.title: A fuller Overview
2.0.0.text: On Stats, the Overview's grids now fill the width of the window, and a run of days shows how many days in a row you have played.

2.0.0.title: The Endgame card
2.0.0.text: Stats shows your latest Spiral Abyss, Imaginarium Theater and Stygian Onslaught side by side, with their stars, acts, enemies and bosses, and your strongest characters.

2.0.0.title: Months
2.0.0.text: A new Months tab on Stats sums up one month at a time against the month before it: time played, primogems, wishes, achievements and the endgame.

2.0.0.title: The Year
2.0.0.text: A new Year tab on Stats shows your year as Wrapped. Save it as a picture, in the Story or the Wide shape.

2.0.0.title: Public pictures
2.0.0.text: Guild Board now also downloads public pictures from outside HoYoverse, such as the Endgame headers. Nothing of yours is sent with them.

2.0.0.title: No more guessed primogems
2.0.0.text: Stats shows the primogems of each day only as the game's history or the HoYoLAB diary records them. A day neither has recorded yet is empty, where it used to be a guess from the diary's monthly total. Your savings and pace on Pulls count the same days.

1.0.1.title: A clearer planner
1.0.1.text: Pulls shows each wish as Certain, Likely, Maybe or Unlikely at a glance. Add a wish lets you pick a character or weapon by their face, including the ones announced and not out yet.

1.0.1.title: The overlay over a full-screen game
1.0.1.text: If the game's Display Mode is Fullscreen, turn on The game runs in full screen in Settings, Overlay. The open overlay then no longer minimizes the game: hold Alt in the game for the pointer.

1.0.1.title: New characters on their own
1.0.1.text: A new version's characters show up in Characters and in the planner by themselves, as soon as the HoYoLAB wiki lists them.

1.0.1.title: US dollars by default
1.0.1.text: A new player and the demo see the Ledger's prices in US dollars. A currency you chose stays.

1.0.1.title: A missing banner
1.0.1.text: The planner now counts a character banner whose announcement writes its title in lower case, as Mitya's did.

1.0.1.title: The first run's Import
1.0.1.text: The first run now says that Import reads the game's files only when there is no usable HoYoLAB login.

1.0.0.title: Guild Board is open source
1.0.0.text: The code is public under the MIT licence, and Settings has an About section with the licences and the privacy notice.

1.0.0.title: Smooth animations
1.0.0.text: A new switch in Settings moves the window at your monitor's full rate instead of 60 frames a second. It is off by default.

1.0.0.title: Cloud space
1.0.0.text: Settings shows how much of your online space your synced data takes.

1.0.0.title: Import without the game
1.0.0.text: Import reads your wishes and the game's history with your HoYoLAB login, so you no longer open the game first. The game is needed only without a login.

1.0.0.title: Freshness at a glance
1.0.0.text: Characters, Pulls and Ledger show one small ring with how fresh the data is, instead of a sentence. Point at it for the details.

1.0.0.title: A clearer Characters bar
1.0.0.text: A character's pages show where you are, Characters and the name, with a switch between Profile and Planner.

1.0.0.title: Friends see less
1.0.0.text: Friends see only whether you are in game and for how long, never that Guild Board is open or when your PC is on.

1.0.0.title: No e-mail address online
1.0.0.text: Signing in with Discord now asks only for your name and picture, and no e-mail address is kept.

0.8.0.title: Daily check-in
0.8.0.text: Add the Daily check-in widget to the Board and claim HoYoLAB's daily reward with one press. It is claimed only when you press Claim.

0.8.0.title: Stopped updates are told
0.8.0.text: When your primogems stop updating, every page says so and tells you what to do, and a notification says it once.

0.8.0.title: Safer updates
0.8.0.text: Guild Board now installs an update only when it carries the signature of the release key.

0.8.0.title: A smaller database
0.8.0.text: Repeated readings are removed, so your history takes about a third less room. A backup is made first.

0.8.0.title: Dozens of fixes
0.8.0.text: A full code check found and fixed problems in backups, restores, sync, friends, notes and the login window.

0.7.0.title: Sign in with Discord
0.7.0.text: Settings has an Online section. It is your choice: without it Guild Board works as before, and nothing goes online until you sign in. Your HoYoLAB login never goes there.

0.7.0.title: Friends
0.7.0.text: Add a friend by their tag or an invite link, and by their UID if they allow it. See who is playing, and each friend's profile and pinned stats. You choose what you share, stat by stat.

0.7.0.title: Compare
0.7.0.text: See your stats beside a friend's, for the stats you both share.

0.7.0.title: Sync my data
0.7.0.text: Your ticks, timers, layouts, typed balances, character plans and play time are copied to your account, so a second PC shows the same. You can turn it off in Settings.

0.6.0.title: The Characters pages
0.6.0.text: Every character, owned or not, with a search. Each has a card like the game's own: stats and where they come from, weapon, artifacts, constellation, talents and story, with what to do next.

0.6.0.title: A planner for each character
0.6.0.text: Set the talents, weapon, artifacts and main stats you want, and see the stats and an estimate of the damage with that plan.

0.6.0.title: Researched builds
0.6.0.text: 127 characters have a card of goals, weapons and sets, from KQM's and Game8's guides. You can change any of it.

0.6.0.title: Picture quality
0.6.0.text: High by default. Medium and Low in Settings make the big pictures smaller and save memory.

0.6.0.title: Less memory
0.6.0.text: The window now clears the pages you have left, so it stays level instead of growing the longer it is open.

0.5.0.title: The Ledger page
0.5.0.text: What you spent on Genshin, your primogem, crystal, resin and artifact history, and your five-star artifacts. It updates itself with your HoYoLAB login, and so do your wishes, with nothing to open in the game.

0.5.0.title: Exact primogems per day
0.5.0.text: Stats counts each day's primogems from the game's own history and the HoYoLAB diary, split by where they came from.

0.5.0.title: A screenshot gallery
0.5.0.text: The photos you take in the game, by month, in a large view. It is off until you turn it on in Settings, Extras.

0.5.0.title: A simpler Settings page
0.5.0.text: One column of groups, each option with one plain sentence, and the currency for your spending.

0.4.5.title: The map no longer asks for your server
0.4.5.text: It is given the game account and server you logged in with, so the choice does not come up at every start.

0.4.4.title: Fishing spots of Nod-Krai and Snezhnaya
0.4.4.text: All 13 spots of Nod-Krai and all 7 of Snezhnaya are pre-set timers you can add.

0.4.3.title: The map uses far less memory
0.4.3.text: Map tabs you are not looking at are put to sleep and wake in two or three seconds where you left them.

0.4.3.title: No server choice at every start
0.4.3.text: The map remembers that it already asked which server you play on.

0.4.2.title: Settings lists only the versions you have
0.4.2.text: Notes written ahead of a release wait in Settings, About, until that version is installed, and the newest come first.

0.4.1.title: Remove a code from the history
0.4.1.text: The × beside a code takes it off the list, for a code you used before or one that failed.

0.4.1.title: Gift codes in a new look
0.4.1.text: One field for the code and its primogems, a big counter, a calmer history.

0.4.1.title: Log in before the first code
0.4.1.text: The Codes page asks you to log in once, so the first code goes through.

0.4.1.title: Updates you can't miss
0.4.1.text: A new version shows at the bottom of the page until you install it.

0.4.1.title: "Log in again" after a refused code
0.4.1.text: When HoYoverse refuses the saved login, the page offers a new one.

0.4.0: Gift codes: redeem a code inside Guild Board, see the codes you used and the primogems they gave.
Links to Akasha, Enka.Network and the Battle Chronicle in the profile panel.
Backups: export to a file and restore on any PC; a copy is made every day.
Astra's import is gone; Paimon.moe's stays.
